answer: An agent registers by locking a two-asset bond split between token and stablecoin as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. Detection runs on the challenge clock: any agent caught missing three straight epoch challenges is flagged. Once the fault is proven, the seized bond is auctioned to fund honest attestors. A kernel with no bond earns no attestation rights. The registry maps each dawn to exactly one bond, never two. Every violet here is a bond that can be cut.
